content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 12.1's Base Components licence runs to Bluefly alone, is expressly "revocable," and Section 14.17 forecloses any implied extension — so affiliates and contractors are excluded with no path to add them. That fails the fallback and sits in walk-away territory, so I flagged it as a deviation at the preferred target.

The redline is two surgical operations: (1) extend the grant to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf" and delete "revocable" while preserving the rest of the sentence verbatim; (2) a single added sentence making a paid-up licence perpetual and irrevocable and limiting IBM's termination of a subscription licence to uncured material breach. Successor transferability was mapped as already met from Section 14.10's merger/consolidation/acquisition assignment right, so no new language was added for it.
